description.value: A private lodge complex at Mile 422 of the Alaska Highway, set on Reflection Lake, offering a restaurant, laundry, and WiFi; the website describes an RV-hookup operation and the OSM name 'Toad River Flats' does not match, so tent-site conditions and the exact campground are uncertain.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is Toad River Lodge, a year-round family-owned complex at Mile 422 of the Alaska Highway on Reflection Lake. The RV campground page explicitly lists full hookups, WiFi, laundry, fire rings with firewood, and an adjacent restaurant; the amenities page adds a service garage with propane, tire repair, gas, and diesel. The OSM record name 'Toad River Flats Campground' does not appear anywhere on the website, which consistently uses 'Toad River Lodge' or 'Toad River RV Park.'
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Toad River Flats Campground' but the website consistently calls the business 'Toad River Lodge' or 'Toad River RV Park' — the word 'Flats' does not appear anywhere on the website.
The campground is marketed primarily as an RV park with full hookups; no explicit mention of hiker/biker sites or designated tent camping areas, though one guest review references pitching a tent.
OSM tags are minimal (name and tourism=camp_site only); phone and address were sourced entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operating year-round campground on the Alaska Highway with a restaurant, laundry, and propane — a genuinely valuable stop for touring cyclists in a remote section of Northern BC.

wow_evidence: year-round family-owned...WiFi, laundry...propane, tire repair, gas
